name: codex-bridge
description: Route user-assigned work bidirectionally between Codex and DeepSeek Harness through Local Agent Bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Route explicitly delegated tasks to a local DeepSeek Harness.
interface.longDescription: When a Codex user affirmatively and directly assigns a task to DSH, DeepSeek Harness, or DeepSeek as the executor, sends the full task to a new real DSH headless run and returns its result through an auditable local bridge. Mere mentions do not trigger delegation.
defaultPrompt: Use DeepSeek Harness to complete this task and verify the result.
Check whether the local agent bridge is ready.
